SELECT
  discharge_outcome,
  -- Median (50th percentile) LOS
  PERCENTILE_CONT(los, 0.50) OVER (PARTITION BY discharge_outcome) AS p50_los,
  -- 75th percentile LOS
  PERCENTILE_CONT(los, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY discharge_outcome) AS p75_los,
  -- 90th percentile LOS
  PERCENTILE_CONT(los, 0.90) OVER (PARTITION BY discharge_outcome) AS p90_los,
  -- 95th percentile LOS
  PERCENTILE_CONT(los, 0.95) OVER (PARTITION BY discharge_outcome) AS p95_los,
  -- % of ICU stays ≤ 7 days
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN los <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100.0 AS pct_le_7d,
  COUNT(*) AS n_stays
FROM (
  SELECT
    icu.subject_id,
    icu.hadm_id,
    icu.los,
    CASE
      WHEN adm.hospital_expire_flag = 1 THEN 'in-hospital death'
      WHEN UPPER(adm.discharge_location) LIKE '%HOSPICE%' THEN 'hospice'
      WHEN UPPER(adm.discharge_location) LIKE 'HOME%' THEN 'home'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS discharge_outcome
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` AS icu
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS pat
    ON icu.subject_id = pat.subject_id
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS adm
    ON icu.subject_id = adm.subject_id
    AND icu.hadm_id = adm.hadm_id
  WHERE
    pat.gender = 'F'
    AND pat.anchor_age BETWEEN 40 AND 50
) sub
WHERE discharge_outcome IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY discharge_outcome
ORDER BY
  CASE discharge_outcome
    WHEN 'home' THEN 1
    WHEN 'hospice' THEN 2
    WHEN 'in-hospital death' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END;

SELECT
  discharge_outcome,
  quantiles[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_los,
  quantiles[OFFSET(75)] AS p75_los,
  quantiles[OFFSET(90)] AS p90_los,
  quantiles[OFFSET(95)] AS p95_los,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sum_le7, total) * 100.0 AS pct_le_7d,
  total AS n_stays
FROM (
  -- Aggregate per discharge outcome
  SELECT
    discharge_outcome,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(los, 100) AS quantiles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN los <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_le7,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM (
    -- Filter to female ICU stays, age 40–50, derive discharge outcome
    SELECT
      icu.los,
      CASE
        WHEN adm.hospital_expire_flag = 1 THEN 'in-hospital death'
        WHEN UPPER(adm.discharge_location) LIKE '%HOSPICE%' THEN 'hospice'
        WHEN UPPER(adm.discharge_location) LIKE 'HOME%' THEN 'home'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS discharge_outcome
    FROM
      `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` AS icu
    JOIN
      `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS pat
      ON icu.subject_id = pat.subject_id
    JOIN
      `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS adm
      ON icu.subject_id = adm.subject_id
     AND icu.hadm_id = adm.hadm_id
    WHERE
      pat.gender = 'F'
      AND pat.anchor_age BETWEEN 40 AND 50
  ) sub
  WHERE discharge_outcome IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY discharge_outcome
)
ORDER BY
  CASE discharge_outcome
    WHEN 'home' THEN 1
    WHEN 'hospice' THEN 2
    WHEN 'in-hospital death' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END;
